answers.valueEn: Fully repainted except for roof and trunk. Traces of front-right impact. Right headlight replaced. Crack in front-right wheel well liner. Impact in the front metal core and radiator support. Cooling kit secured with zip ties. Crack in front bumper grille. Welding on front-right fender edge. Crack in front-left and rear-left fender edges. Cut in rear-left wheel well liner. Crack in engine splash shield. Welding in rear-right rim. Missing trunk shelf. Traces of shellac on cylinder head gasket (internal engine repair), signs of dismantling the tappet cover, timing cover, engine oil pan, and gearbox housing bolts. Cut in driver door and trunk door rubber seals. Damage to the wiring of the front-left interior pillar (scorch). Fading on gear knob. Impact on right middle pillar and front-right door frame from the inside.
